survey: A moon-base card seen from one raised three-quarter camera looking down onto a grey cratered plain. Main parts: (1) A wide, low cylindrical base sitting flat on the ground. Its top rim and bottom edge are open ellipses curving the same way, which fits a camera above the object. (2) A glass dome on the base. Its white ribs curve over it and meet at a small cap on top, and the cap is seen from above. Inside the glass you can see the inner ring, again seen from above. (3) A segmented tunnel joined to the left side of the base. Its axis runs toward the front left. The joint rings bow toward the near end. The near end cap is a narrow ellipse, which fits how far the tunnel turns toward the camera. A yellow door on the end cap is narrowed to match. The tunnel rests on two small block feet on the ground. (4) A metal ladder leaning on the front-right of the base. Its top rests on the rim, its feet stand on the ground in front of the wall, and its rails stay parallel with even rungs. (5) Background craters and rocks. The crater rims are flattened ellipses that match the ground plane and the base's ellipses, so the ground and the object share one view.
